newsitem.title: UK: Capital Corp up after bid approach.
newsitem.headline: Capital Corp up after bid approach.

text.p: Shares in Capital Corp Plc rose on Tuesday after the operator of the Colony Club and Crockfords casinos said it had received an approach that may or may not lead to an offer being made for the company.
The stock was up 17-1/2p at 183-1/2 by 0825 GMT.
In a brief statement, Capital said it had rejected the approach but made no further comment.
Shares in Capital Corp tumbled earlier this month after the company warned of a sharp fall in profits in 1996 to between 8.5 million stg and 9.0 million, from 13.1 million stg the year before.
It said profits had been hit by low levels of "high roller" activity during the final quarter of the year and that punters at its casinos had enjoyed a higher-than-usual level of wins in December.
